selected_branches.branch: Crossing traversal under the stated sight conditions without either exception.

law_text: The prima facie speed limit shall be fifteen miles per hour when traversing a grade crossing of a steam, electric or any other motor railway, if during the last one hundred feet of the approach to such crossing the driver does not have a clear and unobstructed view of such crossing and of any traffic on such railway for a distance of four hundred feet in both directions along such railway. This Section shall not apply in the case of any railway grade crossing where a human flagman is on duty or clearly visible electrical or mechanical railway crossing signal device is installed but does not then indicate the immediate approach of a railway train or car.
